svg.text: Everything runs locally and free on one MacBook. The agent can only ask for actions; the bank API decides.
AI side: understands and plans, holds no bank credentials
Bank side: final say on every rule
All eight phases are built. Ollama serves every model; nothing leaves the laptop.
The agent never reaches the bank tables directly: every action goes agent → MCP → bank API, which re-checks the session, ownership and limits.
